company.name: Origami Therapeutics
company.shortDescription: Origami Therapeutics develops protein degrader therapeutics.
company.description: Origami Therapeutics is developing medicines that target and degrade disease-related proteins as a means of treating disease. They're a preclinical biopharmaceutical company determined to find innovative treatments for neurological disorders, starting with Huntington's disease. Their new protein degraders digest and eliminate disease-causing proteins by utilizing the body's natural protein disposal system. Neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and frontotemporal dementia are the target of its core programs.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for discovering protein degraders and conformation correctors targeting disease-causing proteins in neurodegenerative diseases.

productsAndServices.description: Small molecule drugs designed to selectively degrade disease-causing proteins by harnessing the body’s natural protein disposal systems.
productsAndServices.name: ORIGAMI Protein Degraders

productsAndServices.description: Small molecules that stabilize the proper folding of proteins to prevent toxic misfolding and associated cellular dysfunction.
productsAndServices.name: Protein Conformation Correctors

productsAndServices.description: In vitro patient-derived cell models, including 2D cultures and 3D brain cell spheroids, used to evaluate and optimize drug candidates for neurodegenerative diseases.
productsAndServices.name: Human Disease Cell Models for Drug Discovery

items.description: Origami Therapeutics and Ipsen have entered into a collaboration to develop a targeted protein degrader program for an inherited neurodegenerative disorder, accelerating Origami's path toward clinical development.

Origami Therapeutics and Ipsen entered a global collaboration and option agreement under which Ipsen gains an exclusive option to license Origami’s small‑molecule protein degrader program for a rare inherited neurodegenerative disorder, with Origami eligible for upfront, milestone and royalty payments.
